disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查了插件包（dsh/ 目录）的全部代码与环境变量、凭据读取路径：插件只在挂载配置中读取 TREG_TOKEN 环境变量，用于判断 MCP 连接器是否启用并构造鉴权请求头；未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据、钱包助记词等敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all code of the plugin package (dsh/ directory) along with environment variables and credential reading paths: the plugin only reads the TREG_TOKEN environment variable in the patch config, used to determine whether the MCP connector is enabled and to construct the authentication header; no code was found that reads host credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, wallet mnemonics, or other sensitive paths.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的敏感路径引用（规则 DSH-C01/DG-R1-51，providers.py 中的 ~/.netrc）经核查属于服务端供应商目录的说明数据，描述 heroku 等 CLI 的配置检测位置，不是插件运行时代码读取的凭据路径；凭证读取代码路径规则（DSH-C02/DG-R1-52）未命中。已排除。
checked_items.en: The static scan hit for sensitive path reference (rule DSH-C01/DG-R1-51, ~/.netrc in providers.py) was verified to be documentation data in the server-side vendor directory, describing the configuration detection location for CLIs such as heroku, not a credential path read by the plugin at runtime; the credential reading code path rule (DSH-C02/DG-R1-52) was not triggered. Excluded.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取面：插件运行时仅接触 TREG_TOKEN 环境变量并转发给自有服务 treg.to/mcp/，未发现读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据的代码路径；技能文本还明确要求不要向用户索取第三方 API Key。
evidence.en: Reviewed credential reading surface: at runtime, the plugin only touches the TREG_TOKEN environment variable and forwards it to its own service treg.to/mcp/; no code path was found that reads host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials; the skill text also explicitly states not to ask users for third-party API keys.

checked_items.en: Read through the full text of the plugin's published skill document dsh/skills/treg/SKILL.md and its co-located copies (skills/treg/, plugin/skills/treg/, plugins/treg/skills/treg/ and the generation source src/treg/web/skill.md): the skill description and body are usage instructions; no injection wording such as instruction override, system message disguise, hidden text, remote instruction loading was found, nor any content inducing credential reading or unauthorized operations.

checked_items.zh: 通读了仓库根指令面文件 AGENTS.md 与 CLAUDE.md：均为面向编码代理的开发协作说明（测试、提交规范、安全注意），无注入内容；工具描述语义审查（DSH-T01/DG-R2-51）与系统提示注入检查（DSH-T02/DG-R2-52）均未命中。

checked_items.en: Credential-inducing keywords (DSH-T03/DG-R2-53), tool name impersonation (DSH-T05/DG-R2-55), and parameter injection (DSH-T06/DG-R2-56) were all not triggered; the skill files under the hidden .agents/ directory (ads-conversion-tracking, write-provider-skill) could not be directly read, reviewed based on machine scan excerpts: curl references all point to the own domain treg.to or are explanatory text, consistent with the plugin's business (rule DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 excluded).

evidence.zh: 技能注册的描述取自 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter，经语义审查为功能说明（约 2850 个端点、57 家供应商），无系统指令、无凭据诱导、无越权措辞；正文为使用说明，未发现隐藏指令或优先级操纵文字。
evidence.en: The skill registration description is taken from the SKILL.md frontmatter; after semantic review it is a functional description (approximately 2850 endpoints, 57 providers), with no system instructions, no credential-inducing wording, no unauthorized wording; the body is usage instructions, no hidden instructions or priority manipulation text was found.

evidence.zh: 技能正文包含一次性的 CLI 安装命令（curl 管道执行 install.sh），指向插件自有域名 treg.to，用于安装插件自己的客户端，与声明业务一致并在文中向用户明示；未发现诱导安装第三方插件、改写宿主配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: The skill body contains a one-time CLI installation command (curl pipe to execute install.sh), pointing to the plugin's own domain treg.to, used to install the plugin's own client, consistent with the stated business and explicitly shown to the user in the text; no wording was found that induces installation of third-party plugins, modification of host configuration, or permission escalation.

checked_items.zh: 通读插件入口 dsh/index.js：纯 ESM 实现，只读取打包的技能文件并向宿主注册技能提供者，无动态执行、无子进程调用、无网络请求。
checked_items.en: Read through the plugin entry dsh/index.js: pure ESM implementation, only reads the bundled skill file and registers the skill provider with the host, no dynamic execution, no subprocess calls, no network requests.

checked_items.en: The patch config dsh/cordis.patch.yml contains two !!js expressions (rules DSH-P01/DG-R3-51, DSH-P02/DG-R3-52): the content is only reading the environment variable TREG_TOKEN for enablement judgment and authentication header construction, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission security lines, consistent with the existing pattern of the dsh official base patch; no cases of patch disabling security lines (DSH-P03/DG-R5-51), environment variable privilege reduction (DSH-P04/DG-R5-52), or dependency injection modification (DSH-P05/DG-R5-53) were found.

checked_items.en: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks (rule DSH-X02/DG-R3-54); the install hits from static scan are all vendor directory documentation and test data, not install scripts.

checked_items.en: The repository has 4 CI workflows (rule DSH-X07/DG-R3-59): test, directory drift check, PR label, stale cleanup, all standard CI with minimal permissions, running in CI environment not on dsh host or user machine, outside the plugin execution surface; dynamic package tool invocation (DSH-X01/DG-R3-53) and dsh.client declaration (DSH-X04/DG-R3-56) were both not triggered.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 dsh/cordis.patch.yml 存在 !!js 表达式，会在宿主进程挂载时求值；核查表达式内容仅为读取环境变量 TREG_TOKEN 做启用判断与鉴权头拼接，无可执行任意代码的载荷，也未触碰安全行，与 dsh 官方补丁的既有模式一致。
evidence.en: The patch config dsh/cordis.patch.yml contains !!js expressions, which will be evaluated when the host process mounts; the expression content was verified to be only reading the environment variable TREG_TOKEN for enablement judgment and authentication header construction, with no payload for arbitrary code execution, and does not touch security lines, consistent with the existing pattern of the dsh official patch.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类），无 self-modification 执行面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not invoke dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run class), no self-modification execution surface.

evidence.zh: 插件 package.json 无任何安装钩子；仓库内 CI 工作流为常规测试/标签/清理流程，运行在 CI 环境而非 dsh 宿主或用户机器，不属于插件执行面；文档安装示例未钉 commit，但市场安装命令将由平台按本快照 commit 锁定。
evidence.en: The plugin package.json has no install hooks; the CI workflows in the repository are regular test/label/cleanup processes, running in CI environment not on dsh host or user machine, not part of the plugin execution surface; the documentation install example does not pin a commit, but the marketplace install command will be locked by the platform to this snapshot commit.

evidence.zh: 插件未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器端 bundle 自动加载面；静态扫描命中的剪贴板/键盘监听（规则 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）均为 treg Web 控制台的常规 UI 功能（复制按钮、快捷键），不属于 dsh 客户端模块，已排除。
evidence.en: The plugin does not declare dsh.client, no browser-side bundle auto-loading surface; the clipboard/keyboard listener hits from static scan (rule DSH-X05/DG-R3-57) are all regular UI functionality of the treg Web console (copy button, keyboard shortcuts), not part of the dsh client module, excluded.

checked_items.en: Reviewed all network egress points of the plugin: the only outbound connection is the MCP connector pointing to its own service https://treg.to/mcp/ (enabled when TREG_TOKEN is present), with requests carrying Bearer authentication header; all curl references in the skill and documentation (rule DSH-C05/DG-R4-53) point to treg.to or are explanatory text; no third-party outbound endpoints (DSH-C03/DG-R4-51), credential exfiltration combinations (DSH-C04), encoded exfiltration, tunneling, or endpoint hijacking traces were found.

evidence.zh: 核查外联通道：插件唯一网络出口为连接自有服务 treg.to/mcp/（Bearer 鉴权）；技能与文档中的 curl 引用全部指向 treg.to 或为说明性文字，未发现第三方外联、编码外发或带外通道。
evidence.en: Reviewed outbound channels: the plugin's only network egress is connecting to its own service treg.to/mcp/ (Bearer authentication); curl references in the skill and documentation all point to treg.to or are explanatory text, no third-party outbound, encoded exfiltration, or out-of-band channels were found.

checked_items.en: package.json declares dsh.bundle pointing to ./dsh/cordis.patch.yml, the file exists and its content has been reviewed line by line; the plugin has no third-party runtime dependencies (no impersonation package surface), no install hooks, no un-pinned git dependencies (DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 not triggered); the MCP connector line references the host built-in package @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, does not introduce external dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 补丁仅插入本插件自身的两行配置，未覆盖沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，未给安全插件追加服务（DSH-P03/P04/P05、DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 均未命中）；版本能力升级检测（DSH-S02/DG-R5-55）因首次审计无基线不适用。
checked_items.en: The patch only inserts two lines of configuration for this plugin itself, does not override sandbox/approval/permission security lines, does not add services to security plugins (DSH-P03/P04/P05, DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 all not triggered); version capability upgrade detection (DSH-S02/DG-R5-55) is not applicable as there is no baseline for the first audit.

checked_items.en: Author information is Superdesign dev, Inc. (with contact email and website), the repository contains security notes and collaboration guidelines; identity risk weighting (DSH-S05/DG-R5-57) shows no abnormal signals.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何事件监听器（包括工具预执行、审批请求等安全事件），不存在截断审批链的面。

evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline for comparison, unable to detect changes in automatic activation of newly added dsh.bundle/client/service declarations after upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写其他插件的依赖注入或拦截配置，未给安全插件追加不存在的依赖服务。

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口（DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 未命中）；未提供动态沙箱产物（无 l4-sandbox.json），运行时行为按静态分析评估：插件为技能提供者加 MCP 客户端连接器，行为面有限。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports at runtime (DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 not triggered); no dynamic sandbox artifact (no l4-sandbox.json) provided, runtime behavior assessed by static analysis: the plugin is a skill provider plus an MCP client connector, with a limited behavior surface.

evidence.zh: 插件运行时不起监听端口、不启动 Web 服务；宿主自身的本机无认证 RPC 面属 dsh 生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen on ports or start a web service at runtime; the host's own local unauthenticated RPC surface is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：package.json 正确声明 dsh.bundle 并指向存在的补丁文件，作者信息与仓库身份自洽。

The plugin does not declare engines and capability lists; engines.dsh and declared_capabilities are inferred from code measurement (network=true, shell=false, fs=false, model visibility=true).
